question: The largest inland salt lake ‘Sambhar’ is located in the ____ of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**north-west**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Location: **Sambhar Lake is situated in the state of Rajasthan, India, approximately 64 kilometers Northwest of Jaipur.</li&
